title: Product Photography for New York City Brands
metaTitle: Product Photography for New York City Brands | TDM
metaDescription: Product photography for New York City brands: catalogue, lifestyle and detail images shot by our team in the United States, retouched and channel-ready.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) photographs products for New York City brands: clean catalogue images, styled lifestyle scenes and close detail shots, retouched and delivered in the sizes each sales channel requires. Our team in the United States photographs the products, and the selects go to our operations office in Lahore for retouching and export. You approve the shot list beforehand and review the images online. For labels that sell through their own site, marketplaces and wholesale accounts at once, a consistent image set is part of the product.

sections.heading: A city of product businesses
paragraphs: New York makes and sells an unusual range of physical goods. Fashion labels work out of the Garment District and Brooklyn lofts. Jewellers cluster around the Diamond District on 47th Street. Independent beauty, fragrance and candle brands operate from small studios, and food makers share production space in places like Industry City and the Brooklyn Navy Yard. Many sell nationally from very little space.

Their images are held to a high standard because their buyers are surrounded by good design every day. The same photograph may have to work on a product page, in a marketplace listing with strict rules, in a paid social ad and in a line sheet sent to a store buyer. Studio time and space in the city are costly, and founders often end up photographing new items on a windowsill between other jobs.

sections.heading: What a shoot produces
paragraphs: We first map your catalogue and channels, then define the set list: which angles, scenes and details each product needs. Counts are planned around where the images will be used, because a marketplace listing, a product page and an ad campaign each ask for different pictures.
bullets: Studio catalogue photography on white or coloured backgrounds, lit the same way across the range.
Lifestyle scenes styled with props and surfaces that suit your brand, for ads, social and homepage placements.
Macro shots of materials, finishes, labels and mechanisms.
Image sets specified to meet Amazon and other marketplace requirements for background, framing and resolution.
Retouching that is colour-accurate and honest, since misleading images lead to returns.
Files exported in every crop and resolution you need, organised and named to your convention.

sections.heading: How a shoot for a New York brand runs
paragraphs: Our team in the United States photographs your products against the approved set list, in a setup built for the range or on location when a lifestyle scene calls for a real room. The selects then go to our operations office in Lahore, where they are retouched and shared for review, and your notes are applied before the final export.

Some things should be settled before the shoot. Provide the exact colourways and sizes you intend to sell, with packaging if it will appear in shots. Tell us which pieces need to come back to you and which can be kept for the next round. For high-value goods such as fine jewellery or watches, talk to us first about handling and insurance. How the products reach the shoot is agreed in the plan.

sections.heading: Questions for any product photographer
paragraphs: Ask whether retouching is included and how many revision rounds you get. Ask how colour accuracy is checked, which matters greatly for fabric and cosmetics. Ask whether the lighting setup is recorded, so items added next season match the existing set. And confirm the usage rights: you should be free to use your images across your store, ads and wholesale materials.

faqs.q: Where are products for New York City brands photographed?
faqs.a: In the United States, by our own team, in a setup or location chosen for the brief. Retouching and export are done at our operations office in Lahore.

faqs.q: How much does product photography cost for a New York brand?
faqs.a: It depends on scope: the number of products, the images per product, the styling involved and the formats required. We quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: How long does a product shoot take for a New York brand?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of the range, the styling and the brief. The schedule, including time for review and revisions, is agreed in the plan before the shoot is booked.

faqs.q: Can you photograph a whole catalogue and keep it consistent?
faqs.a: Yes. We build a repeatable lighting and framing setup for each category so every item matches, then batch the shoot and the retouching.

faqs.q: Will the images meet Amazon and marketplace rules?
faqs.a: Image sets can be specified to meet Amazon and other marketplace requirements for background, framing and resolution. Tell us which channels you sell on and we plan the set list around them.
